overview_description.description: Reble offers a software download, only for windows, that allows users to stream music from your friends who also have installed Reble.  It launched into public beta on Feb. 5th, 2008, and is a [Y Combinator](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/y-combinator)-funded company.
